items.title: 鴻華先進代工 三菱正式官宣ASX VR-e進軍紐澳市場
items.title_en: Foxconn Advanced Manufacturing, Mitsubishi Officially Announces ASX VR-e Entry into Australia and New Zealand Market
paras: 三菱汽車(Mitsubishi Motors)正式宣布，將於 2026 年在澳洲和紐西蘭推出「ASX VR-e」純電動車，將由鴻海(2317-TW)子公司鴻華先進-創(2258-TW)以 OEM 方式供應。
全新ASX VR-e車型現已登陸澳洲和紐西蘭小型SUV市場，其推出主要得益於市場對純電動車日益增長的需求，尤其是在城市地區，該車型定位為兼顧卓越環保性能、先進技術、駕駛性能和時尚設計的全新選擇。
「ASX」這個名稱源自於多年來在澳洲和紐西蘭市場廣受歡迎的緊湊型SUV「ASX – Active Sports Crossover (X)」。「VR-e」則源自三菱汽車的高性能運動轎車「Galant VR-4」，象徵著這款車型卓越的運動性能、先進的電氣化技術和許多先進配置。
ASX VR-e外觀設計以卓越的空氣動力學性能為首要考量，配備了獨特的隧道狀「S形導流槽」，以及配備了可根據駕駛狀況降低空氣阻力的「主動式進氣格柵」。前後燈組以及後車柱均採用水平條紋設計，此設計元素也延伸至C柱和特製輪轂，營造出渾然一體的現代感。
三菱汽車正著力強化產品陣容，專注於發展非公路用車和東協市場產品線，在電氣化方面，開發混合動力汽車（HEV）和插電式混合動力汽車（PHEV），並充分利用與聯盟夥伴的合作，力求在環保性能與三菱標誌性的駕駛性能之間取得平衡。
展望未來，三菱汽車將繼續透過與包括聯盟夥伴在內的各方合作，持續豐富產品陣容，並進一步加速電氣化進程。
paras_en: Mitsubishi Motors officially announced that it will launch the all‑electric “ASX VR‑e” in Australia and New Zealand in 2026, with the vehicle to be supplied on an OEM basis by Hon Hai (2317‑TW) subsidiary Hon Hua Advanced‑Creation (2258‑TW).

The new ASX VR‑e has now entered the small‑SUV market in Australia and New Zealand, its launch driven by growing demand for pure‑electric vehicles, especially in urban areas; the model is positioned as a fresh choice that balances outstanding environmental performance, advanced technology, driving dynamics and stylish design.

The name “ASX” comes from the long‑standing popular compact SUV “ASX – Active Sports Crossover (X)” in the Australian and New Zealand markets, while “VR‑e” references Mitsubishi’s high‑performance sports sedan “Galant VR‑4”, symbolising the model’s superior sport performance, advanced electrification technology and numerous cutting‑edge features.

The ASX VR‑e’s exterior design prioritises superior aerodynamics, featuring a distinctive tunnel‑shaped “S‑shaped duct” and an active intake grille that reduces drag according to driving conditions. The front and rear light clusters and the rear pillar use horizontal stripe styling, a motif that extends to the C‑pillar and specially designed wheels to create a cohesive modern look.

Mitsubishi Motors is strengthening its product lineup, focusing on non‑road vehicles and ASEAN market products. In electrification, it is developing hybrid (HEV) and plug‑in hybrid (PHEV) models and leveraging collaborations with alliance partners to balance eco‑performance with Mitsubishi’s signature driving dynamics.
Looking ahead, Mitsubishi Motors will continue to enrich its portfolio through cooperation with alliance partners and others, further accelerating its electrification drive.

items.title: 永鴻生技高附加價值產品銷售比重升 上半年獲利8314萬元年增逾6成
items.title_en: Yonghong Biotech's High-Value-Added Product Sales Share Rises, H1 Profit Reaches NT$83.14 Million, Up Over 60% YoY
paras: 動物藥廠永鴻生技(6936-TW)今(17)日指出，受惠高附加價值產品銷售比重提升，加上深耕國內市場拓展效益顯現，推升上半年稅後純益達8314萬元，年增超過6成，每股純益1.14元。
永鴻累計今年上半年營收7.44億元，年增11.34%；稅後純益8314萬玩，年增61.5%，每股純益1.14元。永鴻生技指出，由於持續優化產品組合並提升營運效率，獲利成長幅度高於營收成長。
永鴻進一步指出，成長動能延續至下半年，各事業產品需求維持穩健，7月營收1.46億元，月增24.13%，年增13.09%，創歷史單月新高；累計今年前7月營收8.91億元，年增11.63%。
展望下半年，永鴻表示，將持續深化動物用藥、寵物健康及微生物發酵等核心事業發展，同時加速海外產品註冊及市場布局，擴展國際市場版圖。
paras_en: Animal drug company Yonghong Biotech (6936-TW) said today (17th) that benefiting from increased share of high‑value‑added product sales and deepening domestic market expansion, its H1 after‑tax net profit rose to NT$83.14 million, up more than 60% year‑over‑year, and earnings per share were NT$1.14.

Yonghong recorded H1 revenue of NT$744 million, up 11.34% YoY; after‑tax net profit of NT$83.14 million, up 61.5% YoY, EPS NT$1.14. The company said that continued optimization of its product mix and improved operating efficiency led profit growth outpacing revenue growth.

Yonghong added that growth momentum will continue into the second half, with demand for all business lines remaining solid. July revenue was NT$146 million, up 24.13% month‑over‑month and 13.09% year‑over‑year, a record single‑month high; cumulative revenue for the first seven months of the year reached NT$891 million, up 11.63% YoY.

Looking ahead to the second half, Yonghong said it will keep deepening development of its core businesses—animal medicines, pet health and microbial fermentation—while accelerating overseas product registrations and market rollout to expand its international footprint.

items.title: AI進入「資本關鍵時刻」？投資敘事轉向融資、巨頭現金流承壓、債市拉響警報
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮正逐步進入新的階段。從最初聚焦技術突破，到企業大舉擴張資本支出，如今市場關注焦點進一步轉向：龐大的AI基礎建設支出究竟要如何融資，以及這些資金成本將由誰承擔。
橋水基金Greg Jensen近日以「我們正在進入資本的關鍵時刻」形容當前AI投資環境，凸顯隨著AI基礎設施建設規模持續擴大，融資問題正逐漸成為市場不可忽視的核心。
摩根士丹利(MS-US) 預估， 2028年以前，全球AI基礎設施建設總支出將達3.2兆美元，其中約1.75兆美元需要透過信貸市場籌措。
此外，AI產業的融資管道也已不再局限於傳統投資級公司債，槓桿貸款、私人信貸及證券化產品等融資方式均開始扮演更重要角色。
問題在於，市場雖然仍有資金，但取得資金的成本正在上升。
債券市場已率先反映這項變化。Apollo數據顯示，AI相關債券目前已占長天期債券供給約40%，代表AI正在大量「吃掉」債券市場的融資容量。
與此同時，超大規模雲端服務商的信用利差今年以來明顯擴大，但整體投資級債券市場的利差變化並不明顯。

AI支出持續增加，自由現金流卻承壓

AI基礎建設投資另一項值得關注的變化，是資本支出預測持續被上調，但企業自由現金流預測卻同步走弱。
摩根士丹利近期大幅下修多家超大規模雲端服務商2027年的自由現金流預測，其中甲骨文(ORCL-US) 的壓力尤其明顯，2027年自由現金流預測已接近負400億美元。
與此同時，超大規模雲端服務商的採購承諾也快速增加，目前已達9820億美元。摩根士丹利指出，企業如今有大量資本支出實際上存在於資產負債表之外，因此若僅觀察帳面上的資產負債表數據，可能無法完整反映企業未來面臨的資金需求。

信貸市場開始提高AI企業風險溢價

隨著AI資本支出規模不斷膨脹，信用市場也開始針對相關企業重新定價。
摩根士丹利數據顯示，今年以來，高品質超大規模雲端服務商的信用利差擴大約25個基點，一般超大規模雲端服務商則擴大約22個基點；同期整體投資級債券市場的信用利差基本沒有變化。
其中，甲骨文成為市場關注度最高的案例之一。
其他超大規模雲端服務商的信用違約交換（CDS）普遍落在30至80個基點區間，但甲骨文CDS自2025年中約40個基點一路攀升，2026年4月一度接近190個基點，目前仍約在180個基點附近。
相較之下，Meta(META-US) 的CDS走勢相對溫和，目前約升至75個基點。
從信用市場的定價來看，AI基礎建設投資所帶來的融資壓力並非平均分布在所有大型雲端服務商身上，市場對甲骨文的風險疑慮尤其明顯。

當前財務體質仍強，市場擔憂的是未來融資需求

值得注意的是，超大規模雲端服務商目前的資產負債表並不算脆弱。
摩根士丹利2026年第一季數據顯示，超大規模雲端服務商總槓桿率僅1.3倍，淨槓桿率為0.5倍，現金對債務比率則高達128%，中位信用評級為AA-。
相較之下，非金融投資級企業整體總槓桿率達2.4倍，信用評級則為BBB。
但問題在於，摩根士丹利預估，2027年雲端運算資本支出增速將由原先預測的14%大幅上修至29%。
分析指出，超大規模雲端服務商仍持續重申對AI投資回報的信心，但資本支出預測大幅上調，也代表未來可能需要面對更大的融資需求。

「新債王」Gundlach質疑GPU能否支撐長期債務

隨著市場開始探索以AI相關資產作為融資抵押品，這類交易本身的資產價值與期限錯配問題，也引發債券市場投資人的質疑。
債券市場知名投資人、在華爾街有著 「新債王」之稱的Jeffrey Gundlach針對一項規模500億美元的基金聯合體計畫提出警告，認為相關安排可能難以經受時間考驗。
Gundlach以尖銳的比喻質疑「用生命週期未知的資產作爲長期債務的抵押品」這件事，甚至稱這還不如一筆以倉庫中的香蕉作為支撐、期限長達30年的資產抵押證券（ABS）交易。
分析指出，他的質疑指向AI融資模式中的核心問題，即GPU折舊速度極快，但技術更新週期遠短於債務存續期。
而當金融機構以這些資產作為抵押品進行長期融資時，抵押資產未來究竟能維持多少價值，便成為融資結構中難以忽視的不確定因素。

items.title: 全球首家「兆美元銀行」將誕生？摩根大通市值已達9650億美元
items.title_en: JPMorgan Chase May Become First $1 Trillion Bank
paras: 受交易與併購業務強勁成長帶動，摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 近三個月股價大漲21%，上週五收盤市值已攀升至9,650億美元，距離1兆美元大關僅約3.6%。富國銀行最新預估，在多項利多支撐下，摩根大通有望成為全球首家市值突破1兆美元的銀行。
富國銀行(WFC-US) 給予摩根大通「增持」評級，並將目標價由375美元上調至390美元，較上週五收盤價仍有逾7%上漲空間。
若股價達到該目標，不僅意味摩根大通可望跨越1兆美元市值門檻，也將進一步拉開與全球其他大型銀行的差距。
不只1兆美元 富國銀行更喊出2兆美元
富國銀行分析師Mike Mayo指出，摩根大通在投資高成長領域方面擁有業界領先能力，不僅有助於突破1兆美元市值，更有望在未來7至8年內向2兆美元邁進。
Mayo認為，過去十年摩根大通在攻守兩端均展現出頂尖水準，不僅持續擴大各核心業務的市場占有率，也全面改善業務結構。相較其他全球性銀行，摩根大通的獲利表現更加穩健，並建立執行長戴蒙（Jamie Dimon）所稱的「堡壘級資產負債表」。
摩根大通近期財報也為股價提供支撐。該行今年第二季創下史上最高單季淨利，達211億美元，年增41%；其中股票交易業務營收年增86%至60億美元，不僅超越分析師預期，也帶動整體交易業務營收升至121億美元，改寫歷史新高。
關鍵不在估值 而是獲利成長
對於摩根大通能否進一步挑戰2兆美元市值，富國銀行認為，關鍵並非單純依靠本益比等估值指標上升，而是每股盈餘（EPS）能否持續實質成長。
Mayo指出，摩根大通已建立一套「自給自足」的正向循環，其有形普通股權益報酬率（ROTCE）持續顯著高於股權成本，使公司得以將超額回報重新投入實體據點、人才、金融科技與國際業務，再將這些投資轉化為市場占有率提升。
這套成長模式已延伸至多項核心業務，包括存款、信用卡、資本市場與傳統銀行業務。Mayo表示，摩根大通正在全方位尋找成長機會，存款業務也不例外。
華爾街多數分析師偏多看待
富國銀行的樂觀預期並非孤例。根據LSEG統計，在追蹤摩根大通的26名分析師中，有15人給予「買進」或「強力買進」評級，顯示華爾街整體仍對其後市抱持正面看法。
以目前9,650億美元市值計算，摩根大通距離1兆美元大關已相當接近。若股價延續近期漲勢，全球首家「兆美元銀行」可能很快誕生。
而市場下一步關注焦點，也將從何時突破1兆美元，轉向富國銀行提出的更長期問題：摩根大通能否靠獲利持續成長，在未來7至8年進一步挑戰2兆美元市值。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase (JPM-US) has seen its stock price surge 21% over the past three months, with its market value reaching $96.5 billion as of last Friday, just 3.6% shy of the $1 trillion milestone.
JPMorgan Chase has been given a 'buy' rating by Wells Fargo (WFC-US), with a target price of $390, up from $375, representing a potential upside of over 7% from last Friday's closing price.
If the stock price reaches the target, it would not only mean JPMorgan Chase is poised to break the $1 trillion market value barrier but also further widen its lead over other major global banks.
Wells Fargo is not only predicting JPMorgan Chase will break the $1 trillion barrier but also predicts it will reach $2 trillion in the future.

Wells Fargo analyst Mike Mayo notes that JPMorgan Chase has a leading position in the high-growth investment space, which not only helps it break the $1 trillion market value barrier but also puts it on track to reach $2 trillion in the next 7-8 years.

Mayo believes that JPMorgan Chase has demonstrated top-notch performance in both offense and defense over the past decade, expanding its market share in core businesses and improving its business structure.
Compared to other global banks, JPMorgan Chase's profit performance has been more stable, and it has established an ' fortress-like' balance sheet, as described by CEO Jamie Dimon.

JPMorgan Chase's recent quarterly earnings have also provided support for the stock price, with the bank reporting a record $21.1 billion in net income, a 41% year-over-year increase, and $6 billion in stock trading revenue, an 86% year-over-year increase.
The key to JPMorgan Chase's continued growth is not just about relying on valuation metrics but also about sustaining earnings per share (EPS) growth.
Wells Fargo believes that the key to JPMorgan Chase's ability to challenge the $2 trillion market value barrier is not just about relying on valuation metrics but also about sustaining EPS growth.

Mayo notes that JPMorgan Chase has established a 'self-sustaining' positive cycle, with its tangible common equity return on tangible common equity (ROTCE) consistently exceeding its cost of equity, allowing the company to reinvest excess returns into physical assets, talent, financial technology, and international business, and then convert these investments into market share gains.

This growth model has been extended to multiple core businesses, including deposits, credit cards, capital markets, and traditional banking business, with Mayo stating that JPMorgan Chase is actively seeking growth opportunities across all areas, including deposits.
Most Wall Street analysts are bullish on JPMorgan Chase, with 15 out of 26 analysts tracked by LSEG giving the bank a 'buy' or 'strong buy' rating.

With a current market value of $96.5 billion, JPMorgan Chase is close to breaking the $1 trillion barrier, and if the stock price continues to rise, the bank may become the first $1 trillion bank in the world.

Market attention will shift from when JPMorgan Chase will break the $1 trillion barrier to whether it can sustain earnings growth and challenge the $2 trillion market value barrier in the next 7-8 years.

items.title: 阿里巴巴15億美元出售遊戲業務「靈犀互娛」重點轉向發展AI
items.title_en: Alibaba Sells Gaming Business Lingxi Games for $1.5 Billion to Focus on AI
paras: 根據多家媒體報導，阿里巴巴(BABA-US)(09988-HK)集團周一(17日)確認將旗下的遊戲業務部門靈犀互娛(Lingxi Games)出售給亞洲私募股權公司信宸資本(Trustar Capital)。這筆交易的價值估計至少達 15 億美元，代表這家電子商務巨頭正透過剝離非核心資產，全力加速向人工智慧(AI)領域轉型。
這次出售是阿里巴巴在首席執行官吳泳銘領導下進行的大規模業務重組之一，集團目前的戰略優先事項已明確轉向 AI 與雲計算，並設定了在五年內實現 1000 億美元 AI 收入的目標。
不久前，阿里巴巴才推出了其史上最大的 AI 模型，性能據稱可與全球領先的 Anthropic 旗鼓相當，旨在挑戰美國競爭對手。
靈犀互娛是阿里巴巴在數位娛樂領域的重要資產，擁有約 1,200 名員工。其旗艦產品、也是營收最高的遊戲為《三國志·戰略版》，這是與日本光榮特庫摩(Koei Tecmo)合作開發的大型多人線上策略手遊，全球用戶已突破 1 億。
此外，公司旗下還擁有《三國志幻想大陸》、《如鳶》、《風之大陸》等知名項目，以及九遊、交易貓等運營部門，這些都將一併納入收購列表。
靈犀互娛執行長周炳樞在內部備忘錄中表示，阿里巴巴將靈犀交由信宸資本是為了「更好地聚焦戰略重點」。他強調，此次交易協議是在友好、共贏的氛圍下達成的，新股東信宸資本充分肯定了靈犀的價值，未來管理團隊將繼續並肩前行，推動公司發展。
先前市場曾傳出三七互娛、巨人網絡等公司均有收購意願，最終由信宸資本勝出接手。
paras_en: Alibaba Group (BABA-US)(09988-HK) confirmed on Monday (17th) that it will sell its gaming business department Lingxi Games to Asian private equity firm Trustar Capital. The transaction is estimated to be worth at least $1.5 billion, representing the e-commerce giant's efforts to divest non-core assets and accelerate its transformation into the artificial intelligence (AI) field.

This sale is one of the large-scale business reorganizations carried out by Alibaba under the leadership of CEO Wu Yongming, with the group's current strategic priorities clearly shifted towards AI and cloud computing, and a target of achieving $100 billion in AI revenue within five years.
Recently, Alibaba launched its largest AI model to date, with performance reportedly comparable to global leader Anthropic, aiming to challenge its US competitors.

Lingxi Games is an important asset of Alibaba in the digital entertainment field, with approximately 1,200 employees. Its flagship product, the highest-grossing game, is 'Three Kingdoms: Strategic Edition', a large-scale online multiplayer strategy game developed in collaboration with Japanese company Koei Tecmo (Koei Tecmo). The game has already surpassed 1 billion users worldwide.

In addition, the company also owns other well-known projects such as 'Three Kingdoms: Fantasy Continent', 'Like a Falcon', 'Wind Continent', as well as the operation departments of Jiu You and Trading Cat, which will all be included in the acquisition list.

Lingxi Games CEO Zhou Bingshou stated in an internal memo that Alibaba will transfer Lingxi to Trustar Capital to 'focus on strategic priorities better'. He emphasized that the transaction agreement was reached in a friendly and win-win atmosphere, with new shareholder Trustar Capital fully recognizing the value of Lingxi, and the management team will continue to work together to drive the company's development.

Earlier, the market had reported that companies such as Three Seven Interactive and Giant Network had expressed interest in acquiring Lingxi Games, but ultimately Trustar Capital won the bid to take over.

items.title: 8月機器人雙展開跑 永豐金證推「參展廠商×資金動能」二大投資指標
items.title_en: Fubon Securities Launches Dual Investment Indicators for Robot and Automation Expo
paras: 「2026台灣機器人與智慧自動化展(TAIROS)」和「台北國際自動化工業大展」將於8月19日起在南港展覽館盛大登場，永豐金證券今(17)日指出，為因應投資人需求創「參展廠商×資金動能」雙重指標，以籌碼面訊號搭配「參展名單」取代單純題材來選股，協助投資人搶先掌握展覽前市場話題。
永豐金證券內部統計，6月輝達執行長黃仁勳旋風來台公開出席台北國際電腦展演講後，連續3個月帶動機器人與輝達生態系題材類股交易人數成長，熱度自5月明顯升溫、平均交易人數較4月增加達50%，且6月和7月熱度延續。
而此熱潮延燒至永豐金證券大戶投APP策略選股專區，7月上線以來「機器人與自動化展概念股」躋身關注度前五大主題，每3位使用功能投資人就有1位鎖定，主要是因概念股專區使用「參展廠商×資金動能」雙重指標，異於一般依市值排序或僅列出供應鏈名單的方式，透過指標篩選出成交值超過5000萬元、且近五日漲幅最強勢的機器人與自動化概念股，用「資金正在買」的真訊號，協助投資人以更嶄新的角度檢視機會。
台灣機器人與智慧自動化展今年聚焦高靈敏度機械手臂、自主移動機器人(AMR)、AI視覺感測，呼應近期市場對機器人零組件訂單能見度提升的樂觀預期，黃仁勳多次於公開場合強調「實體AI(Physical AI)將是AI下一波十兆美元級市場」，加上特斯拉Optimus等人形機器人陸續進入小規模量產，今年已被市場視為人形機器人量產元年。
永豐投顧指出，從籌碼面來看，市場評價重心正在從單純資本支出規模，轉向商業化落地能力。
永豐金證券近期更推出「策略共識股」，系統每日同步統計旗下46套策略選股結果，依「被選中次數」排序，次數越多代表越多面向策略同時看好。
paras_en: Fubon Securities announced on August 17 that the 2026 Taiwan Robot and Intelligent Automation Exhibition (TAiros) and the Taipei International Automation Industry Exhibition will take place at the Nangang Exhibition Hall from August 19. To meet the demands of investors, Fubon Securities has created a dual indicator called "Participating Companies x Capital Momentum" to help investors grasp market trends before the exhibition.

According to Fubon Securities' internal statistics, after Fubon's executive director, Huang Ren-xun, attended the Taipei International Computer Exhibition and gave a speech, the number of investors trading robot and related stocks has grown for three consecutive months. The heat has been rising since May, with an average increase of 50% compared to April, and has continued into June and July.

The heat wave has also spread to Fubon Securities' APP strategy selection zone, where the "Robot and Automation Exhibition Concept Stocks" have become one of the top five topics since its launch in July. Every three users of the APP strategy selection zone has one user focusing on the concept stocks, mainly due to the use of the "Participating Companies x Capital Momentum" dual indicator, which is different from the general method of sorting by market value or listing only the supply chain names.

The Taiwan Robot and Intelligent Automation Exhibition this year focuses on high-sensitivity mechanical arms, autonomous mobile robots (AMR), and AI vision sensing, which responds to the recent market optimism about the visibility of robot component orders. Huang Ren-xun has repeatedly emphasized in public that "Physical AI (Physical AI) will be the next trillion-dollar market for AI," and with Tesla's Optimus and other humanoid robots entering small-scale production, this year has been seen as the year of humanoid robot production.
Fubon Securities pointed out that from a capital perspective, the market evaluation is shifting from the simple capital expenditure scale to the commercialization and landing ability.

Fubon Securities has recently launched the "Strategy Consensus Stock" system, which synchronizes and sorts the results of 46 strategy selection systems every day based on the "selection frequency". The more frequent the selection, the more strategies are looking good.

items.title: 中信銀主辦矽品5年期500億元永續連結聯合授信 12家銀行超額認購
items.title_en: Citic Bank Leads 12 Banks in Oversubscribed $5 Billion Syndicated Loan for SinoPac
paras: 中信銀行今(17)日宣布，矽品五年期新台幣500億元永續連結聯合授信案圓滿完成，由中信銀擔任統籌主辦暨管理銀行，攜手兆豐國際商業銀行、合作金庫商業銀行及華南商業銀行共同主辦，最終獲12家銀行踴躍參與且超額認購，本案原訂籌組金額新台幣 400 億元，增額至 500 億元圓滿簽約，顯示金融機構對矽品營運實力、產業地位及未來發展前景深具信心。
中信銀指出，矽品為日月光投資控股股份有限公司旗下重要子公司，身為全球半導體封裝與測試產業領導廠商，深耕先進封裝、高階測試及系統整合技術，服務全球眾多國際半導體設計與製造客戶。
近年受惠於人工智慧(AI)、高效能運算(HPC)、雲端運算、車用電子及高速通訊等應用需求快速成長，帶動先進封裝技術需求攀升，矽品持續強化技術研發與產能布局，積極掌握全球半導體產業成長契機，提升市場競爭力；在創新技術與提升產能的同時，矽品亦提升能源管理及營運效率，展現兼顧企業成長與永續發展的經營方向。
此次聯合授信案成功籌組，展現銀行團對矽品長期發展策略、技術實力及市場競爭優勢的高度肯定，將助力矽品推動先進製程投資、擴充產能及優化營運布局，鞏固其在全球半導體供應鏈中的關鍵地位。中信銀行則透過多元金融服務，協助企業掌握產業發展機會，支持客戶提升競爭力並穩健邁向永續轉型。
本聯合授信案銀行團包含中信銀行、兆豐國際商業銀行、合作金庫商業銀行、華南商業銀行、元大商業銀行、臺灣中小企業銀行、臺灣土地銀行、上海商業儲蓄銀行、中國建設銀行臺北分行、台北富邦商業銀行、彰化商業銀行及遠東國際商業銀行等 12 家金融業者共同參與，展現金融業對半導體產業及具國際競爭力企業的支持，以實際行動協助產業升級，並攜手推動產業朝高效能、低碳化及永續發展方向邁進，強化台灣科技產業發展動能。
paras_en: Citic Bank announced today that the five-year NT$50 billion syndicated loan for SinoPac has been successfully completed. Citic Bank served as the lead arranger and manager, working with Fubon International Commercial Bank, Cooperative Bank, and China Development Financial to co-arrange the loan. A total of 12 banks participated in the loan, exceeding the initial target of NT$40 billion, with the final amount increasing to NT$50 billion. This demonstrates the confidence of financial institutions in SinoPac's operating strength, industry position, and future development prospects.

Citic Bank noted that SinoPac is a key subsidiary of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) and a leading global provider of semiconductor packaging and testing services. SinoPac has a strong focus on advanced packaging, high-end testing, and system integration technologies, serving numerous international semiconductor design and manufacturing customers.

In recent years, SinoPac has benefited from the rapid growth of demand for artificial intelligence (AI), high-performance computing (HPC), cloud computing, automotive electronics, and high-speed communication. This has driven up demand for advanced packaging technologies, enabling SinoPac to continuously strengthen its technology research and development and production capacity, actively seizing the growth opportunities in the global semiconductor industry and enhancing its market competitiveness. At the same time, SinoPac has improved its energy management and operational efficiency, demonstrating its commitment to balancing corporate growth and sustainable development.

The successful syndicated loan demonstrates the high recognition of the banking group for SinoPac's long-term development strategy, technical capabilities, and market competitiveness. This will help SinoPac drive investments in advanced processes, expand production capacity, and optimize its operational layout, solidifying its position in the global semiconductor supply chain. Citic Bank will provide diversified financial services to help enterprises grasp industry development opportunities, support customers in enhancing their competitiveness, and promote sustainable transformation.

The syndicated loan was participated by 12 banks, including Citic Bank, Fubon International Commercial Bank, Cooperative Bank, China Development Financial, E.Sun Commercial Bank, Taiwan SME Bank, Land Bank of Taiwan, Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank, China Construction Bank Taipei Branch, Taipei Fubon Commercial Bank, Changhua Commercial Bank, and Far Eastern International Commercial Bank. This demonstrates the financial industry's support for the semiconductor industry and internationally competitive companies, with actual actions to assist industry upgrading and promote the development of high-efficiency, low-carbon, and sustainable industries, enhancing Taiwan's technological industry development momentum.

items.title: 〈億光法說〉原物料漲勢趨緩助下半年毛利率改善 泰國新廠2027年投產布局AI與機器人
items.title_en: 億光:原物料漲勢趨緩助下半年毛利率改善
paras: LED廠億光(2393-TW)今(17)日舉辦法說會，公司看好下半年營運表現將優於上半年，隨著原物料漲價趨勢逐步趨緩並適度轉嫁客戶，毛利率表現可望較上半年改善，且2027年泰國新廠投產，並持續布局機器人以及AI相關新興領域。
泰國新廠預計將於2027年3月逐步完工並陸續引進生產設備，下半年完成驗收試產，最快在同年第三季至第四季正式邁向量產階段。該廠初期規劃將以毛利率較高的消費性電子LED元件為主，今明兩年一般性設備採購資本支出則維持在5億至10億元水準。
中長期產品佈局上，億光持續將車用與不可見光列為公司未來的核心成長動能。針對中國車廠出口擴大，特別是電動車領域，億光已全面供應閱讀燈與氛圍燈等車內元件，以及尾燈和煞車燈與頭燈等車外應用，目前整體市場份額仍具備顯著提升空間。
在新興高階應用領域，億光鎖定AI伺服器商機，旗下高階光耦合器出貨占比已達到20%以上，並積極與國際大廠客戶合作進行規格設計。在機器人市場方面，公司主力供應機械手臂與掃地機器人所需的伺服馬達控制開關光耦合器及避障感測器，同時為無人機開發高功率紅外線LED，更已提早切入零組件用量龐大的人型機器人市場。
在先進技術與新材料拓展上，億光在充電樁等明確訂單挹注下，今年第三類半導體營收預期將呈現雙位數成長，雖然今明兩年占總營收比重預估不會超過1%，但屬於實質成長的新產品線。
針對CPO元件領域，億光現階段透過轉投資布局Micro LED在短距離光傳輸的應用，持續尋求最合適的市場切入點。
paras_en: Epistar (2393-TW) held a conference call today, expecting better-than-expected performance in the second half of the year, as the trend of rising raw material prices gradually slows down and is moderately passed on to customers, leading to improved profitability. The company also plans to continue investing in AI and robotics.

The new factory in Thailand is expected to be completed in stages from March 2027, with production equipment being gradually introduced in the second half of the year. The factory will officially enter the mass production phase by the end of the year. The initial plan is to focus on high-margin consumer electronics LED components.

In the medium- to long-term product layout, Epistar will continue to focus on automotive and invisible light as the company's core growth drivers. To address the expansion of Chinese automakers' exports, especially in the electric vehicle sector, Epistar has fully supplied reading lights and ambient lights for vehicle interiors, as well as tail lights and brake lights and headlights for vehicle exteriors.

In the emerging high-end application field, Epistar has targeted the AI server market, with high-end optical coupling products accounting for over 20% of shipments. The company is actively cooperating with international major customers to design specifications. In the robotics market, Epistar is mainly supplying mechanical arm and vacuum cleaner robots with servo motor control switches and obstacle detection sensors.

In the field of advanced technologies and new materials, Epistar expects its third-generation semiconductor revenue to grow by double digits this year, driven by clear orders for charging stations. Although the proportion of total revenue is expected to remain below 1% in the next two years, it represents a substantial growth in new product lines.

Regarding the CPO component field, Epistar is currently exploring the application of Micro LED in short-distance optical transmission through investment. The company is seeking the most suitable market entry point.

items.title: 鴻華先進代工 三菱正式官宣ASX VR-e進軍紐澳市場
items.title_en: Foxconn Advanced Manufacturing, Mitsubishi Officially Announces ASX VR-e Entry into Australia and New Zealand Market
paras: 三菱汽車(Mitsubishi Motors)正式宣布，將於 2026 年在澳洲和紐西蘭推出「ASX VR-e」純電動車，將由鴻海(2317-TW)子公司鴻華先進-創(2258-TW)以 OEM 方式供應。
全新ASX VR-e車型現已登陸澳洲和紐西蘭小型SUV市場，其推出主要得益於市場對純電動車日益增長的需求，尤其是在城市地區，該車型定位為兼顧卓越環保性能、先進技術、駕駛性能和時尚設計的全新選擇。
「ASX」這個名稱源自於多年來在澳洲和紐西蘭市場廣受歡迎的緊湊型SUV「ASX – Active Sports Crossover (X)」。「VR-e」則源自三菱汽車的高性能運動轎車「Galant VR-4」，象徵著這款車型卓越的運動性能、先進的電氣化技術和許多先進配置。
ASX VR-e外觀設計以卓越的空氣動力學性能為首要考量，配備了獨特的隧道狀「S形導流槽」，以及配備了可根據駕駛狀況降低空氣阻力的「主動式進氣格柵」。前後燈組以及後車柱均採用水平條紋設計，此設計元素也延伸至C柱和特製輪轂，營造出渾然一體的現代感。
三菱汽車正著力強化產品陣容，專注於發展非公路用車和東協市場產品線，在電氣化方面，開發混合動力汽車（HEV）和插電式混合動力汽車（PHEV），並充分利用與聯盟夥伴的合作，力求在環保性能與三菱標誌性的駕駛性能之間取得平衡。
展望未來，三菱汽車將繼續透過與包括聯盟夥伴在內的各方合作，持續豐富產品陣容，並進一步加速電氣化進程。
paras_en: Mitsubishi Motors officially announced that it will launch the all‑electric “ASX VR‑e” in Australia and New Zealand in 2026, with the vehicle to be supplied on an OEM basis by Hon Hai (2317‑TW) subsidiary Hon Hua Advanced‑Creation (2258‑TW).

The new ASX VR‑e has now entered the small‑SUV market in Australia and New Zealand, its launch driven by growing demand for pure‑electric vehicles, especially in urban areas; the model is positioned as a fresh choice that balances outstanding environmental performance, advanced technology, driving dynamics and stylish design.

The name “ASX” comes from the long‑standing popular compact SUV “ASX – Active Sports Crossover (X)” in the Australian and New Zealand markets, while “VR‑e” references Mitsubishi’s high‑performance sports sedan “Galant VR‑4”, symbolising the model’s superior sport performance, advanced electrification technology and numerous cutting‑edge features.

The ASX VR‑e’s exterior design prioritises superior aerodynamics, featuring a distinctive tunnel‑shaped “S‑shaped duct” and an active intake grille that reduces drag according to driving conditions. The front and rear light clusters and the rear pillar use horizontal stripe styling, a motif that extends to the C‑pillar and specially designed wheels to create a cohesive modern look.

Mitsubishi Motors is strengthening its product lineup, focusing on non‑road vehicles and ASEAN market products. In electrification, it is developing hybrid (HEV) and plug‑in hybrid (PHEV) models and leveraging collaborations with alliance partners to balance eco‑performance with Mitsubishi’s signature driving dynamics.
Looking ahead, Mitsubishi Motors will continue to enrich its portfolio through cooperation with alliance partners and others, further accelerating its electrification drive.

items.title: 永鴻生技高附加價值產品銷售比重升 上半年獲利8314萬元年增逾6成
items.title_en: Yonghong Biotech's High-Value-Added Product Sales Share Rises, H1 Profit Reaches NT$83.14 Million, Up Over 60% YoY
paras: 動物藥廠永鴻生技(6936-TW)今(17)日指出，受惠高附加價值產品銷售比重提升，加上深耕國內市場拓展效益顯現，推升上半年稅後純益達8314萬元，年增超過6成，每股純益1.14元。
永鴻累計今年上半年營收7.44億元，年增11.34%；稅後純益8314萬玩，年增61.5%，每股純益1.14元。永鴻生技指出，由於持續優化產品組合並提升營運效率，獲利成長幅度高於營收成長。
永鴻進一步指出，成長動能延續至下半年，各事業產品需求維持穩健，7月營收1.46億元，月增24.13%，年增13.09%，創歷史單月新高；累計今年前7月營收8.91億元，年增11.63%。
展望下半年，永鴻表示，將持續深化動物用藥、寵物健康及微生物發酵等核心事業發展，同時加速海外產品註冊及市場布局，擴展國際市場版圖。
paras_en: Animal drug company Yonghong Biotech (6936-TW) said today (17th) that benefiting from increased share of high‑value‑added product sales and deepening domestic market expansion, its H1 after‑tax net profit rose to NT$83.14 million, up more than 60% year‑over‑year, and earnings per share were NT$1.14.

Yonghong recorded H1 revenue of NT$744 million, up 11.34% YoY; after‑tax net profit of NT$83.14 million, up 61.5% YoY, EPS NT$1.14. The company said that continued optimization of its product mix and improved operating efficiency led profit growth outpacing revenue growth.

Yonghong added that growth momentum will continue into the second half, with demand for all business lines remaining solid. July revenue was NT$146 million, up 24.13% month‑over‑month and 13.09% year‑over‑year, a record single‑month high; cumulative revenue for the first seven months of the year reached NT$891 million, up 11.63% YoY.

Looking ahead to the second half, Yonghong said it will keep deepening development of its core businesses—animal medicines, pet health and microbial fermentation—while accelerating overseas product registrations and market rollout to expand its international footprint.

台灣機器人與智慧自動化展今年聚焦高靈敏度機械手臂、自主移動機器人(AMR)、AI視覺感測，呼應近期市場對機器人零組件訂單能見度提升的樂觀預期，黃仁勳多次於公開場合強調「實體AI(Physical AI)將是AI下一波十兆美元級市場」，加上特斯拉Optimus等人形機器人陸續進入小規模量產，今年已被市場視為人形機器人量產元年。
永豐投顧指出，從籌碼面來看，市場評價重心正在從單純資本支出規模，轉向商業化落地能力。
永豐金證券近期更推出「策略共識股」，系統每日同步統計旗下46套策略選股結果，依「被選中次數」排序，次數越多代表越多面向策略同時看好。
paras_en: Fubon Securities announced on August 17 that the 2026 Taiwan Robot and Intelligent Automation Exhibition (TAiros) and the Taipei International Automation Industry Exhibition will take place at the Nangang Exhibition Hall from August 19. To meet the demands of investors, Fubon Securities has created a dual indicator called "Participating Companies x Capital Momentum" to help investors grasp market trends before the exhibition.

According to Fubon Securities' internal statistics, after Fubon's executive director, Huang Ren-xun, attended the Taipei International Computer Exhibition and gave a speech, the number of investors trading robot and related stocks has grown for three consecutive months. The heat has been rising since May, with an average increase of 50% compared to April, and has continued into June and July.

The heat wave has also spread to Fubon Securities' APP strategy selection zone, where the "Robot and Automation Exhibition Concept Stocks" have become one of the top five topics since its launch in July. Every three users of the APP strategy selection zone has one user focusing on the concept stocks, mainly due to the use of the "Participating Companies x Capital Momentum" dual indicator, which is different from the general method of sorting by market value or listing only the supply chain names.

The Taiwan Robot and Intelligent Automation Exhibition this year focuses on high-sensitivity mechanical arms, autonomous mobile robots (AMR), and AI vision sensing, which responds to the recent market optimism about the visibility of robot component orders. Huang Ren-xun has repeatedly emphasized in public that "Physical AI (Physical AI) will be the next trillion-dollar market for AI," and with Tesla's Optimus and other humanoid robots entering small-scale production, this year has been seen as the year of humanoid robot production.
Fubon Securities pointed out that from a capital perspective, the market evaluation is shifting from the simple capital expenditure scale to the commercialization and landing ability.

Fubon Securities has recently launched the "Strategy Consensus Stock" system, which synchronizes and sorts the results of 46 strategy selection systems every day based on the "selection frequency". The more frequent the selection, the more strategies are looking good.

items.title: 台新新光金攜手兩廳院打造夏日爵士戶外派對 數萬樂迷齊聚同樂
items.title_en: Taishin Shin Kong Financial Partners with Two Theatres to Host Summer Jazz Outdoor Party, Tens of Thousands of Fans Gather
paras: 一年一度的「台新新光金控兩廳院夏日爵士戶外派對」15 日晚間 6 點 30 分在兩廳院藝文廣場熱鬧展開，現場吸引數萬名熱愛音樂的民眾到場同歡。台新新光金控連續7年冠名贊助兩廳院夏日爵士戶外派對，今年適逢台新新光金控合併滿一周年，特別邀集三組風格鮮明的音樂組合，包括彭郁雯五重奏、臺灣拉丁重擊及金曲臺語歌后李竺芯登台獻藝，為數萬民眾帶來難得的音樂饗宴，在夏夜星空下隨著音樂盡情搖擺留下美好回憶，並與台新新光金控共同歡慶合併一周年的新里程碑。

台新新光金控總經理林維俊表示，兩廳院長年舉辦爵士音樂節以及夏日爵士派對，已成為國內外爵士音樂家交流砥礪的最佳舞台，也是臺灣爵士樂迷不可錯過的盛宴；本於支持藝文發展以培養國人藝術視野、豐富心靈與生活的初衷，台新新光金控自 2020 年起即冠名贊助兩廳院夏日爵士戶外派對，今年的活動適逢台新新光金控合併滿一周年，非常感謝兩廳院精心安排三組國內的音樂表演工作者為民眾帶來精彩的演出，展現臺灣爵士跨界融合的豐富樣貌。
在今年的「台新新光金控兩廳院夏日爵士戶外派對」表演中，彭郁雯五重奏融合客家山歌、童謠與爵士即興，勾勒細膩且富實驗張力的樂章；臺灣拉丁重擊帶來戶外派對最大編制，以澎湃能量與熱情節奏改編民謠，點燃全場；李竺芯則是用嶄新爵士編曲詮釋臺語創作，呈現不同以往的演唱面貌。
除了重量級爵士音樂家表演外，活動現場民眾也爭相到台新新光金控設置的帳篷區掃描指定 QR CODE，並在完成簡單的任務後帶回NFC技術打造的「台新新光金控兩廳院夏日爵士戶外派對紀念專輯造型吊飾」。台新新光金控善盡企業社會責任，持續在各面向回饋社會，在每一年的夏日爵士戶外派對中為爵士樂迷留下一次又一次難忘的回憶。
paras_en: The annual "Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding Two Theatres Summer Jazz Outdoor Party" kicked off at 6:30 p.m. on the 15th at the Two Theatres Arts Plaza, drawing tens of thousands of music lovers. Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding has sponsored the event for seven consecutive years, and this year marks the first anniversary of its merger. The company invited three distinct musical groups—the Peng Yu‑wen Quintet, Taiwan Latin Percussion, and Golden Melody Taiwanese‑language song queen Li Zhu‑xin—to perform, offering a rare musical feast for the crowd. Under the summer night sky, attendees swayed to the music, creating lasting memories while celebrating the merger’s milestone together with Taishin Shin Kong.

Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding’s General Manager Lin Wei‑jun said the Two Theatres’ annual jazz festivals and summer jazz parties have become the premier stage for domestic and international jazz musicians to exchange ideas, and an unmissable event for Taiwan’s jazz fans. Since 2020, the firm has been the title sponsor of the outdoor summer jazz party, supporting arts development to broaden the public’s artistic vision and enrich lives. This year’s event coincides with the one‑year anniversary of the company’s merger, and he thanked the Two Theatres for carefully arranging three local music acts that showcase the rich, cross‑genre fusion of Taiwanese jazz.

During this year’s "Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding Two Theatres Summer Jazz Outdoor Party," the Peng Yu‑wen Quintet blended Hakka mountain songs, children’s tunes, and jazz improvisation to craft delicate, experimentally charged passages. Taiwan Latin Percussion delivered the largest ensemble for an outdoor party, igniting the venue with powerful energy and passionate rhythms that re‑interpreted folk songs. Li Zhu‑xin presented Taiwanese‑language compositions with fresh jazz arrangements, revealing a new vocal style unlike her previous performances.

Beyond the headline jazz performances, attendees flocked to the Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding tent area to scan a designated QR code. After completing a simple task, they received a commemorative album‑style pendant created with NFC technology for the "Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding Two Theatres Summer Jazz Outdoor Party." The company continues to fulfill its corporate social responsibility by giving back to society in various ways, ensuring each summer jazz outdoor party leaves jazz fans with unforgettable memories.

items.title: 中信銀主辦矽品5年期500億元永續連結聯合授信 12家銀行超額認購
items.title_en: Citic Bank Leads 12 Banks in Oversubscribed $5 Billion Syndicated Loan for SinoPac
paras: 中信銀行今(17)日宣布，矽品五年期新台幣500億元永續連結聯合授信案圓滿完成，由中信銀擔任統籌主辦暨管理銀行，攜手兆豐國際商業銀行、合作金庫商業銀行及華南商業銀行共同主辦，最終獲12家銀行踴躍參與且超額認購，本案原訂籌組金額新台幣 400 億元，增額至 500 億元圓滿簽約，顯示金融機構對矽品營運實力、產業地位及未來發展前景深具信心。
中信銀指出，矽品為日月光投資控股股份有限公司旗下重要子公司，身為全球半導體封裝與測試產業領導廠商，深耕先進封裝、高階測試及系統整合技術，服務全球眾多國際半導體設計與製造客戶。
近年受惠於人工智慧(AI)、高效能運算(HPC)、雲端運算、車用電子及高速通訊等應用需求快速成長，帶動先進封裝技術需求攀升，矽品持續強化技術研發與產能布局，積極掌握全球半導體產業成長契機，提升市場競爭力；在創新技術與提升產能的同時，矽品亦提升能源管理及營運效率，展現兼顧企業成長與永續發展的經營方向。
此次聯合授信案成功籌組，展現銀行團對矽品長期發展策略、技術實力及市場競爭優勢的高度肯定，將助力矽品推動先進製程投資、擴充產能及優化營運布局，鞏固其在全球半導體供應鏈中的關鍵地位。中信銀行則透過多元金融服務，協助企業掌握產業發展機會，支持客戶提升競爭力並穩健邁向永續轉型。
本聯合授信案銀行團包含中信銀行、兆豐國際商業銀行、合作金庫商業銀行、華南商業銀行、元大商業銀行、臺灣中小企業銀行、臺灣土地銀行、上海商業儲蓄銀行、中國建設銀行臺北分行、台北富邦商業銀行、彰化商業銀行及遠東國際商業銀行等 12 家金融業者共同參與，展現金融業對半導體產業及具國際競爭力企業的支持，以實際行動協助產業升級，並攜手推動產業朝高效能、低碳化及永續發展方向邁進，強化台灣科技產業發展動能。
paras_en: Citic Bank announced today that the five-year NT$50 billion syndicated loan for SinoPac has been successfully completed. Citic Bank served as the lead arranger and manager, working with Fubon International Commercial Bank, Cooperative Bank, and China Development Financial to co-arrange the loan. A total of 12 banks participated in the loan, exceeding the initial target of NT$40 billion, with the final amount increasing to NT$50 billion. This demonstrates the confidence of financial institutions in SinoPac's operating strength, industry position, and future development prospects.

Citic Bank noted that SinoPac is a key subsidiary of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) and a leading global provider of semiconductor packaging and testing services. SinoPac has a strong focus on advanced packaging, high-end testing, and system integration technologies, serving numerous international semiconductor design and manufacturing customers.

In recent years, SinoPac has benefited from the rapid growth of demand for artificial intelligence (AI), high-performance computing (HPC), cloud computing, automotive electronics, and high-speed communication. This has driven up demand for advanced packaging technologies, enabling SinoPac to continuously strengthen its technology research and development and production capacity, actively seizing the growth opportunities in the global semiconductor industry and enhancing its market competitiveness. At the same time, SinoPac has improved its energy management and operational efficiency, demonstrating its commitment to balancing corporate growth and sustainable development.

The successful syndicated loan demonstrates the high recognition of the banking group for SinoPac's long-term development strategy, technical capabilities, and market competitiveness. This will help SinoPac drive investments in advanced processes, expand production capacity, and optimize its operational layout, solidifying its position in the global semiconductor supply chain. Citic Bank will provide diversified financial services to help enterprises grasp industry development opportunities, support customers in enhancing their competitiveness, and promote sustainable transformation.

The syndicated loan was participated by 12 banks, including Citic Bank, Fubon International Commercial Bank, Cooperative Bank, China Development Financial, E.Sun Commercial Bank, Taiwan SME Bank, Land Bank of Taiwan, Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank, China Construction Bank Taipei Branch, Taipei Fubon Commercial Bank, Changhua Commercial Bank, and Far Eastern International Commercial Bank. This demonstrates the financial industry's support for the semiconductor industry and internationally competitive companies, with actual actions to assist industry upgrading and promote the development of high-efficiency, low-carbon, and sustainable industries, enhancing Taiwan's technological industry development momentum.

items.title: 〈億光法說〉原物料漲勢趨緩助下半年毛利率改善 泰國新廠2027年投產布局AI與機器人
items.title_en: 億光:原物料漲勢趨緩助下半年毛利率改善
paras: LED廠億光(2393-TW)今(17)日舉辦法說會，公司看好下半年營運表現將優於上半年，隨著原物料漲價趨勢逐步趨緩並適度轉嫁客戶，毛利率表現可望較上半年改善，且2027年泰國新廠投產，並持續布局機器人以及AI相關新興領域。
泰國新廠預計將於2027年3月逐步完工並陸續引進生產設備，下半年完成驗收試產，最快在同年第三季至第四季正式邁向量產階段。該廠初期規劃將以毛利率較高的消費性電子LED元件為主，今明兩年一般性設備採購資本支出則維持在5億至10億元水準。
中長期產品佈局上，億光持續將車用與不可見光列為公司未來的核心成長動能。針對中國車廠出口擴大，特別是電動車領域，億光已全面供應閱讀燈與氛圍燈等車內元件，以及尾燈和煞車燈與頭燈等車外應用，目前整體市場份額仍具備顯著提升空間。
在新興高階應用領域，億光鎖定AI伺服器商機，旗下高階光耦合器出貨占比已達到20%以上，並積極與國際大廠客戶合作進行規格設計。在機器人市場方面，公司主力供應機械手臂與掃地機器人所需的伺服馬達控制開關光耦合器及避障感測器，同時為無人機開發高功率紅外線LED，更已提早切入零組件用量龐大的人型機器人市場。
在先進技術與新材料拓展上，億光在充電樁等明確訂單挹注下，今年第三類半導體營收預期將呈現雙位數成長，雖然今明兩年占總營收比重預估不會超過1%，但屬於實質成長的新產品線。
針對CPO元件領域，億光現階段透過轉投資布局Micro LED在短距離光傳輸的應用，持續尋求最合適的市場切入點。
paras_en: Epistar (2393-TW) held a conference call today, expecting better-than-expected performance in the second half of the year, as the trend of rising raw material prices gradually slows down and is moderately passed on to customers, leading to improved profitability. The company also plans to continue investing in AI and robotics.

The new factory in Thailand is expected to be completed in stages from March 2027, with production equipment being gradually introduced in the second half of the year. The factory will officially enter the mass production phase by the end of the year. The initial plan is to focus on high-margin consumer electronics LED components.

In the medium- to long-term product layout, Epistar will continue to focus on automotive and invisible light as the company's core growth drivers. To address the expansion of Chinese automakers' exports, especially in the electric vehicle sector, Epistar has fully supplied reading lights and ambient lights for vehicle interiors, as well as tail lights and brake lights and headlights for vehicle exteriors.

In the emerging high-end application field, Epistar has targeted the AI server market, with high-end optical coupling products accounting for over 20% of shipments. The company is actively cooperating with international major customers to design specifications. In the robotics market, Epistar is mainly supplying mechanical arm and vacuum cleaner robots with servo motor control switches and obstacle detection sensors.

In the field of advanced technologies and new materials, Epistar expects its third-generation semiconductor revenue to grow by double digits this year, driven by clear orders for charging stations. Although the proportion of total revenue is expected to remain below 1% in the next two years, it represents a substantial growth in new product lines.

Regarding the CPO component field, Epistar is currently exploring the application of Micro LED in short-distance optical transmission through investment. The company is seeking the most suitable market entry point.

items.title: 〈億光法說〉車用產品線成Q2營收主要引擎 銅鑼廠Q4交割
items.title_en: EPILED’s Earnings Call: Automotive Products Drive Q2 Revenue, Copper Plant to Close in Q4
paras: LED廠億光(2393-TW)今(17)日召開法人說明會，億光受惠車用產品出貨強勁，車用業務躍居第二季營收成長的主要動能，帶動單季合併營收繳出季增6.4%的亮眼表現。與此同時，公司積極推進資產活化計畫，日前公告處分的台灣銅鑼廠預計將於今年第四季完成交割。
車用產品線成為推升整體業績向上的核心主力，應用範疇廣泛涵蓋車用背光與車載不可見光元件。其餘產品線則呈現持平或小幅變動態勢，目前不可見光產品占比約40%，消費性電子產品占25%，背光與車用產品各占13%，照明產品則占9%。
針對外界關注的銅鑼廠處分案，億光指出相關交易依照進度推進中，預估交割時間落在今年第四季。公司處分該廠主要考量為集中集團內部資源並靈活調配資產配置，藉此提升整體資產報酬率與經營效率，未來全球生產重鎮將聚焦於台灣苑裡、土城，以及中國大陸蘇州與廣東等核心基地。
億光提到，短期內除了銅鑼廠之外並無其他資產處分計畫，將持續把充裕資金與資源投注於具長期成長潛力之策略性投資。
在各產品線獲利表現方面，車用產品因包含毛利較佳的車載背光，其毛利率水準僅次於消費性電子與不可見光，表現明顯優於整體平均值。儘管第二季毛利率受到原物料成本上漲與人民幣匯率波動影響而承壓，但受惠於費用控管與業外評價利益挹注，上半年每股稅後純益仍繳出2.14元水準。
paras_en: LED manufacturer Epiled (2393‑TW) held a corporate briefing today (the 17th). The company benefited from strong shipments of automotive products, with the automotive segment becoming the main driver of second‑quarter revenue growth and delivering a robust 6.4% quarter‑over‑quarter increase in consolidated revenue. At the same time, the firm is actively advancing its asset revitalisation plan and has announced that the disposal of its Taiwan copper‑plant will be completed in the fourth quarter of this year.

The automotive product line is the core engine pushing overall performance higher, covering a wide range of applications such as vehicle backlighting and invisible‑light components for cars. The other product lines are flat or showing only minor changes; currently invisible‑light products account for about 40% of sales, consumer electronics 25%, backlighting and automotive products each 13%, and lighting products 9%.

Regarding the much‑watched copper‑plant disposal, Epiled said the transaction is proceeding on schedule and is expected to close in the fourth quarter of this year. The rationale for selling the plant is to concentrate internal group resources and flexibly re‑allocate assets, thereby improving overall asset returns and operating efficiency. Going forward, the company’s global manufacturing hubs will focus on core sites in Yuanli and Tucheng in Taiwan, as well as Suzhou and Guangdong in mainland China.

Epiled added that, aside from the copper‑plant sale, there are no other asset‑disposal plans in the short term, and it will continue to invest its ample cash and resources into strategic investments with long‑term growth potential.

In terms of profitability across product lines, automotive products—thanks to the higher‑margin vehicle backlighting—rank second only to consumer electronics and invisible‑light products in gross‑margin level, clearly outperforming the overall average. Although Q2 gross margin was pressured by rising raw‑material costs and RMB exchange‑rate fluctuations, effective cost control and non‑operating valuation gains helped the company deliver a first‑half earnings per share of NT$2.14 after tax.

items.title: 賴清德：明年在稅出平衡下每人普發現金1萬元 讓AI紅利全民共享
items.title_en: Tsai Ing-wen: Next Year, Every Person Will Receive NT$10,000 in Cash Under Tax Balance, Let AI Dividends be Shared by All
paras: 行政院於今(17)日上午第2次向總統賴清德報告明(116)年中央總預算編列情形。賴清德在聽取簡報後表示，台灣憑藉長期的半導體、資通訊等供應鏈優勢，經濟成長率上修，今(115)年可望創下39年來新高，明年總預算將在歲入歲出平衡、實質零舉債下，增列2,357億元普發現金予每人1萬元，讓「AI紅利，全民共享」。
賴清德指出，2周前，當他首次聽取「116年度總預算案」報告時，當時他就提到，明年總預算案要在財政穩健的基礎上，兼顧國家安全、經濟發展與人民照顧，也要讓經濟成長的成果由全民共享，這2周行政團隊一方面進行總預算的朝野協商；另一方面，持續進行明年度預算整編。上周五(14日)，主計總處公布最新的經濟數字也可看到，台灣的經濟表現持續上修，相較之前預測更為強韌。
賴清德表示，今年第1季經濟成長率從14.55%上修到15.43%；第2季初步統計也達到12.93%，已連3季呈現雙位數成長，上半年的經濟成長率更達到14.15%，是半世紀以來同期最強表現，今年全年經濟成長率，據主計總處最新預測，從原先的9.64%上修到11.05%，可望創下39年以來新高的紀錄。
賴清德說，這樣亮眼的數字，是全體台灣人民一起打拚的成果，雖面臨動盪的國際政經局勢，面對國內的政治紛擾，依然能夠穩健向前，交出亮眼的成績單，在AI、高效能運算及雲端服務需求快速增加，台灣憑藉長期累積的半導體、資通訊及製造供應鏈優勢，相關訂單、出口及投資也持續成長，成為今年經濟強勁成長的重要動能。
然而，賴清德也強調，必須正視，經濟成長是全民共同創造，但每一個人感受到成長速度並不完全相同，AI蓬勃發展、科技業出口暢旺，是台灣的機會，但在科技業之外，還有更多國人，每一天在服務業、在傳產、在中小微企業殷勤打拚。
政府也不會只關注科技產業的高峰，因此伴隨經濟成長上修，明年總預算歲入，也上修到3兆9,266億元，在歲入歲出平衡前提下，決定增列2,357億元，用來明年普發現金，每人1萬元，全民共享。
賴清德也說，這1萬元怎麼使用，由每個人、每個家庭自己決定，可以拿來支付孩子的教育費，可以照顧長輩，可以減輕家庭負擔，也可以增加消費、支持在地店家及百工百業。但他也強調，普發現金納入整體預算後，明年度總預算仍然維持收支平衡，債務淨額沒有增加，要照顧人民眼前的需要，也對未來的世代負責，分享經濟成長的果實，也守住國家財政的紀律。
paras_en: The Executive Yuan reported to President Tsai Ing-wen on the central government's budget for next year. After listening to the report, Tsai Ing-wen stated that Taiwan's economy is expected to grow at a rate that will be the highest in 39 years, thanks to its long-term advantages in the semiconductor and ICT supply chains. The budget for next year will be balanced, with no debt increase, and an additional NT$235.7 billion will be allocated to give every person NT$10,000 in cash, allowing everyone to share in the 'AI dividend'.

Tsai Ing-wen pointed out that two weeks ago, when he first heard the report on the '2024 budget', he mentioned that the budget for next year should be based on a stable financial foundation, taking into account national security, economic development, and people's welfare, and that the results of economic growth should be shared by all. Over the past two weeks, the administrative team has been engaged in cross-party negotiations on the budget and has continued to review and revise the budget for next year.

Tsai Ing-wen stated that the economic growth rate for the first quarter of this year has been revised upward from 14.55% to 15.43%, and the preliminary statistics for the second quarter also reached 12.93%, with three consecutive quarters of double-digit growth. The economic growth rate for the first half of the year reached 14.15%, the strongest performance in half a century. According to the latest forecast by the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, the annual economic growth rate is expected to be revised upward from 9.64% to 11.05%, which would be a new high in 39 years.

Tsai Ing-wen said that these impressive numbers are the result of the joint efforts of all Taiwanese people. Despite facing a turbulent international political and economic situation and domestic political turmoil, Taiwan has been able to move forward steadily and achieve remarkable results. With the rapid growth in demand for AI, high-performance computing, and cloud services, Taiwan's long-term accumulation of advantages in the semiconductor, ICT, and manufacturing supply chains has led to continuous growth in related orders, exports, and investment, which has become an important driving force for this year's strong economic growth.

However, Tsai Ing-wen also emphasized that it is necessary to recognize that economic growth is a joint creation of all people, but the speed of growth is not felt equally by everyone. The prosperity of AI and the booming export of the tech industry are opportunities for Taiwan, but outside of the tech industry, there are many more people who are working hard every day in the service industry, traditional industries, and small and medium-sized enterprises.

The government will not only focus on the high points of the tech industry. With the upward revision of economic growth, next year's total budget revenue will also be revised upward to NT$3.9266 trillion. On the premise of balancing revenue and expenditure, it has been decided to add NT$235.7 billion to distribute NT$10,000 in cash to every person next year, allowing everyone to share in the benefits.

Tsai Ing-wen also said that how the NT$10,000 is used will be decided by each individual and each family. It can be used to pay for children's education, take care of the elderly, reduce family burdens, or increase consumption and support local businesses and industries. However, he also emphasized that after the cash distribution is included in the overall budget, the total budget for next year will still maintain a balance between revenue and expenditure, and the net debt will not increase. The government needs to take care of people's immediate needs while being responsible to future generations, sharing the fruits of economic growth while maintaining the discipline of national finances.

items.title: AI進入「資本關鍵時刻」？投資敘事轉向融資、巨頭現金流承壓、債市拉響警報
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮正逐步進入新的階段。從最初聚焦技術突破，到企業大舉擴張資本支出，如今市場關注焦點進一步轉向：龐大的AI基礎建設支出究竟要如何融資，以及這些資金成本將由誰承擔。
橋水基金Greg Jensen近日以「我們正在進入資本的關鍵時刻」形容當前AI投資環境，凸顯隨著AI基礎設施建設規模持續擴大，融資問題正逐漸成為市場不可忽視的核心。
摩根士丹利(MS-US) 預估， 2028年以前，全球AI基礎設施建設總支出將達3.2兆美元，其中約1.75兆美元需要透過信貸市場籌措。
此外，AI產業的融資管道也已不再局限於傳統投資級公司債，槓桿貸款、私人信貸及證券化產品等融資方式均開始扮演更重要角色。
問題在於，市場雖然仍有資金，但取得資金的成本正在上升。
債券市場已率先反映這項變化。Apollo數據顯示，AI相關債券目前已占長天期債券供給約40%，代表AI正在大量「吃掉」債券市場的融資容量。
與此同時，超大規模雲端服務商的信用利差今年以來明顯擴大，但整體投資級債券市場的利差變化並不明顯。

AI支出持續增加，自由現金流卻承壓

AI基礎建設投資另一項值得關注的變化，是資本支出預測持續被上調，但企業自由現金流預測卻同步走弱。
摩根士丹利近期大幅下修多家超大規模雲端服務商2027年的自由現金流預測，其中甲骨文(ORCL-US) 的壓力尤其明顯，2027年自由現金流預測已接近負400億美元。
與此同時，超大規模雲端服務商的採購承諾也快速增加，目前已達9820億美元。摩根士丹利指出，企業如今有大量資本支出實際上存在於資產負債表之外，因此若僅觀察帳面上的資產負債表數據，可能無法完整反映企業未來面臨的資金需求。

信貸市場開始提高AI企業風險溢價

隨著AI資本支出規模不斷膨脹，信用市場也開始針對相關企業重新定價。
摩根士丹利數據顯示，今年以來，高品質超大規模雲端服務商的信用利差擴大約25個基點，一般超大規模雲端服務商則擴大約22個基點；同期整體投資級債券市場的信用利差基本沒有變化。
其中，甲骨文成為市場關注度最高的案例之一。
其他超大規模雲端服務商的信用違約交換（CDS）普遍落在30至80個基點區間，但甲骨文CDS自2025年中約40個基點一路攀升，2026年4月一度接近190個基點，目前仍約在180個基點附近。
相較之下，Meta(META-US) 的CDS走勢相對溫和，目前約升至75個基點。
從信用市場的定價來看，AI基礎建設投資所帶來的融資壓力並非平均分布在所有大型雲端服務商身上，市場對甲骨文的風險疑慮尤其明顯。

當前財務體質仍強，市場擔憂的是未來融資需求

值得注意的是，超大規模雲端服務商目前的資產負債表並不算脆弱。
摩根士丹利2026年第一季數據顯示，超大規模雲端服務商總槓桿率僅1.3倍，淨槓桿率為0.5倍，現金對債務比率則高達128%，中位信用評級為AA-。
相較之下，非金融投資級企業整體總槓桿率達2.4倍，信用評級則為BBB。
但問題在於，摩根士丹利預估，2027年雲端運算資本支出增速將由原先預測的14%大幅上修至29%。
分析指出，超大規模雲端服務商仍持續重申對AI投資回報的信心，但資本支出預測大幅上調，也代表未來可能需要面對更大的融資需求。

「新債王」Gundlach質疑GPU能否支撐長期債務

隨著市場開始探索以AI相關資產作為融資抵押品，這類交易本身的資產價值與期限錯配問題，也引發債券市場投資人的質疑。
債券市場知名投資人、在華爾街有著 「新債王」之稱的Jeffrey Gundlach針對一項規模500億美元的基金聯合體計畫提出警告，認為相關安排可能難以經受時間考驗。
Gundlach以尖銳的比喻質疑「用生命週期未知的資產作爲長期債務的抵押品」這件事，甚至稱這還不如一筆以倉庫中的香蕉作為支撐、期限長達30年的資產抵押證券（ABS）交易。
分析指出，他的質疑指向AI融資模式中的核心問題，即GPU折舊速度極快，但技術更新週期遠短於債務存續期。
而當金融機構以這些資產作為抵押品進行長期融資時，抵押資產未來究竟能維持多少價值，便成為融資結構中難以忽視的不確定因素。

items.title: 全球首家「兆美元銀行」將誕生？摩根大通市值已達9650億美元
items.title_en: JPMorgan Chase May Become First $1 Trillion Bank
paras: 受交易與併購業務強勁成長帶動，摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 近三個月股價大漲21%，上週五收盤市值已攀升至9,650億美元，距離1兆美元大關僅約3.6%。富國銀行最新預估，在多項利多支撐下，摩根大通有望成為全球首家市值突破1兆美元的銀行。
富國銀行(WFC-US) 給予摩根大通「增持」評級，並將目標價由375美元上調至390美元，較上週五收盤價仍有逾7%上漲空間。
若股價達到該目標，不僅意味摩根大通可望跨越1兆美元市值門檻，也將進一步拉開與全球其他大型銀行的差距。
不只1兆美元 富國銀行更喊出2兆美元
富國銀行分析師Mike Mayo指出，摩根大通在投資高成長領域方面擁有業界領先能力，不僅有助於突破1兆美元市值，更有望在未來7至8年內向2兆美元邁進。
Mayo認為，過去十年摩根大通在攻守兩端均展現出頂尖水準，不僅持續擴大各核心業務的市場占有率，也全面改善業務結構。相較其他全球性銀行，摩根大通的獲利表現更加穩健，並建立執行長戴蒙（Jamie Dimon）所稱的「堡壘級資產負債表」。
摩根大通近期財報也為股價提供支撐。該行今年第二季創下史上最高單季淨利，達211億美元，年增41%；其中股票交易業務營收年增86%至60億美元，不僅超越分析師預期，也帶動整體交易業務營收升至121億美元，改寫歷史新高。
關鍵不在估值 而是獲利成長
對於摩根大通能否進一步挑戰2兆美元市值，富國銀行認為，關鍵並非單純依靠本益比等估值指標上升，而是每股盈餘（EPS）能否持續實質成長。
Mayo指出，摩根大通已建立一套「自給自足」的正向循環，其有形普通股權益報酬率（ROTCE）持續顯著高於股權成本，使公司得以將超額回報重新投入實體據點、人才、金融科技與國際業務，再將這些投資轉化為市場占有率提升。
這套成長模式已延伸至多項核心業務，包括存款、信用卡、資本市場與傳統銀行業務。Mayo表示，摩根大通正在全方位尋找成長機會，存款業務也不例外。
華爾街多數分析師偏多看待
富國銀行的樂觀預期並非孤例。根據LSEG統計，在追蹤摩根大通的26名分析師中，有15人給予「買進」或「強力買進」評級，顯示華爾街整體仍對其後市抱持正面看法。
以目前9,650億美元市值計算，摩根大通距離1兆美元大關已相當接近。若股價延續近期漲勢，全球首家「兆美元銀行」可能很快誕生。
而市場下一步關注焦點，也將從何時突破1兆美元，轉向富國銀行提出的更長期問題：摩根大通能否靠獲利持續成長，在未來7至8年進一步挑戰2兆美元市值。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase (JPM-US) has seen its stock price surge 21% over the past three months, with its market value reaching $96.5 billion as of last Friday, just 3.6% shy of the $1 trillion milestone.
JPMorgan Chase has been given a 'buy' rating by Wells Fargo (WFC-US), with a target price of $390, up from $375, representing a potential upside of over 7% from last Friday's closing price.
If the stock price reaches the target, it would not only mean JPMorgan Chase is poised to break the $1 trillion market value barrier but also further widen its lead over other major global banks.
Wells Fargo is not only predicting JPMorgan Chase will break the $1 trillion barrier but also predicts it will reach $2 trillion in the future.

Wells Fargo analyst Mike Mayo notes that JPMorgan Chase has a leading position in the high-growth investment space, which not only helps it break the $1 trillion market value barrier but also puts it on track to reach $2 trillion in the next 7-8 years.

Mayo believes that JPMorgan Chase has demonstrated top-notch performance in both offense and defense over the past decade, expanding its market share in core businesses and improving its business structure.
Compared to other global banks, JPMorgan Chase's profit performance has been more stable, and it has established an ' fortress-like' balance sheet, as described by CEO Jamie Dimon.

JPMorgan Chase's recent quarterly earnings have also provided support for the stock price, with the bank reporting a record $21.1 billion in net income, a 41% year-over-year increase, and $6 billion in stock trading revenue, an 86% year-over-year increase.
The key to JPMorgan Chase's continued growth is not just about relying on valuation metrics but also about sustaining earnings per share (EPS) growth.
Wells Fargo believes that the key to JPMorgan Chase's ability to challenge the $2 trillion market value barrier is not just about relying on valuation metrics but also about sustaining EPS growth.

Mayo notes that JPMorgan Chase has established a 'self-sustaining' positive cycle, with its tangible common equity return on tangible common equity (ROTCE) consistently exceeding its cost of equity, allowing the company to reinvest excess returns into physical assets, talent, financial technology, and international business, and then convert these investments into market share gains.

This growth model has been extended to multiple core businesses, including deposits, credit cards, capital markets, and traditional banking business, with Mayo stating that JPMorgan Chase is actively seeking growth opportunities across all areas, including deposits.
Most Wall Street analysts are bullish on JPMorgan Chase, with 15 out of 26 analysts tracked by LSEG giving the bank a 'buy' or 'strong buy' rating.

With a current market value of $96.5 billion, JPMorgan Chase is close to breaking the $1 trillion barrier, and if the stock price continues to rise, the bank may become the first $1 trillion bank in the world.

Market attention will shift from when JPMorgan Chase will break the $1 trillion barrier to whether it can sustain earnings growth and challenge the $2 trillion market value barrier in the next 7-8 years.

items.title: 阿里巴巴15億美元出售遊戲業務「靈犀互娛」重點轉向發展AI
items.title_en: Alibaba Sells Gaming Business Lingxi Games for $1.5 Billion to Focus on AI
paras: 根據多家媒體報導，阿里巴巴(BABA-US)(09988-HK)集團周一(17日)確認將旗下的遊戲業務部門靈犀互娛(Lingxi Games)出售給亞洲私募股權公司信宸資本(Trustar Capital)。這筆交易的價值估計至少達 15 億美元，代表這家電子商務巨頭正透過剝離非核心資產，全力加速向人工智慧(AI)領域轉型。
這次出售是阿里巴巴在首席執行官吳泳銘領導下進行的大規模業務重組之一，集團目前的戰略優先事項已明確轉向 AI 與雲計算，並設定了在五年內實現 1000 億美元 AI 收入的目標。
不久前，阿里巴巴才推出了其史上最大的 AI 模型，性能據稱可與全球領先的 Anthropic 旗鼓相當，旨在挑戰美國競爭對手。
靈犀互娛是阿里巴巴在數位娛樂領域的重要資產，擁有約 1,200 名員工。其旗艦產品、也是營收最高的遊戲為《三國志·戰略版》，這是與日本光榮特庫摩(Koei Tecmo)合作開發的大型多人線上策略手遊，全球用戶已突破 1 億。
此外，公司旗下還擁有《三國志幻想大陸》、《如鳶》、《風之大陸》等知名項目，以及九遊、交易貓等運營部門，這些都將一併納入收購列表。
靈犀互娛執行長周炳樞在內部備忘錄中表示，阿里巴巴將靈犀交由信宸資本是為了「更好地聚焦戰略重點」。他強調，此次交易協議是在友好、共贏的氛圍下達成的，新股東信宸資本充分肯定了靈犀的價值，未來管理團隊將繼續並肩前行，推動公司發展。
先前市場曾傳出三七互娛、巨人網絡等公司均有收購意願，最終由信宸資本勝出接手。
paras_en: Alibaba Group (BABA-US)(09988-HK) confirmed on Monday (17th) that it will sell its gaming business department Lingxi Games to Asian private equity firm Trustar Capital. The transaction is estimated to be worth at least $1.5 billion, representing the e-commerce giant's efforts to divest non-core assets and accelerate its transformation into the artificial intelligence (AI) field.

This sale is one of the large-scale business reorganizations carried out by Alibaba under the leadership of CEO Wu Yongming, with the group's current strategic priorities clearly shifted towards AI and cloud computing, and a target of achieving $100 billion in AI revenue within five years.
Recently, Alibaba launched its largest AI model to date, with performance reportedly comparable to global leader Anthropic, aiming to challenge its US competitors.

Lingxi Games is an important asset of Alibaba in the digital entertainment field, with approximately 1,200 employees. Its flagship product, the highest-grossing game, is 'Three Kingdoms: Strategic Edition', a large-scale online multiplayer strategy game developed in collaboration with Japanese company Koei Tecmo (Koei Tecmo). The game has already surpassed 1 billion users worldwide.

In addition, the company also owns other well-known projects such as 'Three Kingdoms: Fantasy Continent', 'Like a Falcon', 'Wind Continent', as well as the operation departments of Jiu You and Trading Cat, which will all be included in the acquisition list.

Lingxi Games CEO Zhou Bingshou stated in an internal memo that Alibaba will transfer Lingxi to Trustar Capital to 'focus on strategic priorities better'. He emphasized that the transaction agreement was reached in a friendly and win-win atmosphere, with new shareholder Trustar Capital fully recognizing the value of Lingxi, and the management team will continue to work together to drive the company's development.

Earlier, the market had reported that companies such as Three Seven Interactive and Giant Network had expressed interest in acquiring Lingxi Games, but ultimately Trustar Capital won the bid to take over.

items.title: 高盛評美股第二季財報：AI基礎設施大賺 應用端獲利仍處「畫餅」階段
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Sees AI Infrastructure Boom, But Application End Still in 'Painting by Numbers' Stage
paras: 高盛研究部美國首席股票策略師 Ben Snider 在最新報告中指出，雖然企業在人工智慧(AI)領域的支出正急劇加速，但這項技術目前尚未為大多數公司帶來實質的獲利改善。報告強調，AI 對企業獲利的影響仍處於早期且極其有限的階段。
根據對標普 500 指數第二季財報的分析，指數每股收益(EPS)較去年同期增長了 31%。其中，受惠於 AI 資本支出的基礎設施類股票(如晶片製造商、雲端服務商)利潤大幅增長 54%，貢獻了整體增長的一半。
相較之下，標普 500 指數成分股的中位數盈利增幅僅為 14%，非 AI 基礎設施類公司的增幅同樣為 14%，這突顯了硬體供應商與應用端企業之間顯著的獲利落差。
對於大多數企業而言，AI 的投資回報仍難以衡量。報告顯示，僅有 2% 的公司能具體量化 AI 對盈利的貢獻，而提到 AI 提升生產力的公司也僅占 11%。
儘管量化生產力提升的公司盈利中位數增長為 17%，稍高於未量化公司的 14%，但高盛指出這一差異在統計學上並不顯著。
在支出趨勢方面，企業對 AI 的投入正在顯著增加。月人均 AI 支出中位數從年初的 5 美元上升至 7 月的 12 美元，支出排名前 10% 的企業更從 240 美元飆升至 650 美元。然而，約三分之二的企業是透過挪用現有預算來支付 AI 費用，而非投入全新資金，其中 18% 來自軟體預算，11% 來自人力成本。
儘管如此，目前尚未有明確證據顯示 AI 支出正在侵蝕軟體行業的整體收入。
高盛預測，未來最大的受益者可能是勞動力成本高且自動化潛力大的企業，例如工業類公司(勞動力成本占 21%)。潛在受惠名單包括波音、摩根士丹利、eBay、Airbnb 及洛克希德·馬丁等，但其財務回報目前仍多處於承諾階段，尚未顯示出實質增長。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs' US equity strategist Ben Snider notes in a recent report that while corporate spending on artificial intelligence (AI) is accelerating rapidly, the technology has yet to deliver tangible profit improvements for most companies. The report emphasizes that AI's impact on corporate profitability is still in its early and extremely limited stage.

According to an analysis of the S&P 500 index's second-quarter earnings reports, the index's earnings per share (EPS) grew 31% year-over-year. Among the beneficiaries of AI capital spending were infrastructure stocks (such as chipmakers and cloud service providers), which saw profits surge 54% and contributed half of the overall growth.

In contrast, the median profit growth of S&P 500 constituents was 14%, while non-AI infrastructure companies also saw a 14% increase, highlighting a significant profit gap between hardware suppliers and application-end companies.

For most companies, the return on investment in AI remains difficult to measure. The report shows that only 2% of companies can quantify the contribution of AI to their profits, while 11% mention AI as a factor in productivity gains.

Although companies that can quantify productivity gains saw a median profit growth of 17%, slightly higher than that of unquantified companies at 14%, Goldman notes that this difference is not statistically significant.

In terms of spending trends, corporate investment in AI is increasing significantly. The median monthly per-capita AI spending rose from $5 at the start of the year to $12 in July, while the top 10% of spenders saw their spending jump from $240 to $650. However, about two-thirds of companies are paying for AI by reallocating existing budgets, rather than investing new funds, with 18% coming from software budgets and 11% from personnel costs.
Despite this, there is currently no clear evidence that AI spending is eroding the overall revenue of the software industry.

Goldman predicts that the biggest beneficiaries in the future may be companies with high labor costs and significant automation potential, such as industrial companies (with labor costs accounting for 21%). Potential beneficiaries include Boeing, Morgan Stanley, eBay, Airbnb, and Lockheed Martin, but their financial returns are currently mostly in the promise stage and have not yet shown tangible growth.

items.title: Anthropic估值玩大的！華爾街直接看到2028年，IPO身價全看2,000億美元營收能否達標
paras: 2026年08月17日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Anthropic準備挑戰史上最大規模IPO之一，但華爾街面臨的難題是，公司成長速度太快、AI基礎設施支出又太高，現在的營收與獲利已很難作為估值基準。Anthropic今年5月公布的營收年化速度才超過470億美元，如今投資銀行與投資人卻已把目光直接拉到2028年，根據公司約1,900億至2,000億美元的營收預測套用估值倍數。
這代表將來Anthropic上市後的售價，實際上是在要求投資人提前買進未來兩年的高速成長。真正的問題不是公司目前能不能獲利，而是GPU、模型訓練與推論等龐大成本，能否隨規模擴大而低於營收增速。若2028年營收接近2,000億美元、利潤率同步擴張，高估值才有支撐；反過來說，只要成長速度或成本改善不如預期，建立在遠期營收上的估值也會更加敏感。

2028年營收要接近2,000億美元
根據知情人士透露，Anthropic預估2028年營收約1,900億至2,000億美元。相較公司今年5月公布超過470億美元的營收年化速度，意味未來兩年仍需要大幅成長。
若單純以470億美元與2028年1,900億至2,000億美元相比，規模約需要再擴大至目前的4倍。這也是為什麼Anthropic的IPO不能只看今年財務數字，投資銀行與投資人正直接採用2028年預估營收，再乘上企業價值／營收倍數來推算合理估值。
高成長軟體公司使用營收倍數並不罕見，特別是尚未形成穩定獲利模式的企業。但一般IPO估值較少直接看到兩年後，Anthropic之所以成為例外，關鍵就在於營收規模變化太快。
Anthropic表示，2025年底營收年化速度約90億美元，今年5月已突破470億美元。公司並預估2026年第2季營收至少109億美元，較前一季增加逾一倍，單季營業利益則有望首次轉正至5.59億美元。
換句話說，Anthropic現在的財務數字可能幾個季度後就失去代表性，華爾街才會選擇把估值基準往更遠的2028年移動。

Palantir、Cloudflare與SpaceX成為估值參考
另一個難題是，市場幾乎找不到與Anthropic完全相同的上市公司，因此投資銀行正從不同角度尋找可比較標的。
知情人士指出，Palantir、Cloudflare及SpaceX都是Anthropic分析師日之前的重要估值參考。三家公司代表的比較邏輯並不相同。
Palantir代表的是高速成長與AI題材帶來的高估值，目前企業價值約為市場預估今年營收的53倍；Cloudflare則較接近高速成長軟體與基礎設施公司的商業模式，約為2026年預估營收的41.6倍。
SpaceX同樣約為2026年預估營收的41.6倍，但市場給予高估值的原因，更偏向對未來規模的期待。這與Anthropic目前的處境相似：投資人看的並非企業現在已經產生多少獲利，而是數年後可能形成多大的營收與獲利規模。
這些公司並不能直接套用在Anthropic身上，但會影響市場願意給Anthropic多少營收倍數。

2兆美元估值，關鍵不是營收而是成本
如果Anthropic真的達成2028年接近2,000億美元營收，估值想像空間自然會快速放大。有鑑於SpaceX的前例，Anthropic取得2兆美元估值並非不可能，但問題在於這樣的價格能否長期維持。
原因在於，Anthropic目前仍需要投入大量資金購買GPU與運算容量，同時負擔模型訓練、推論與人才成本。營收快速增加，不代表新增收入最後都能轉化成獲利。
Anthropic目前的估值邏輯建立在另一項假設上：隨著模型與硬體效率改善，訓練及推論每單位成本逐步下降；另一方面，人員與其他營運費用不需要跟著營收等比例增加。只要營收成長快於這些成本，營業利益率就有機會隨規模擴大而上升。
因此，市場真正需要判斷的不是Anthropic能不能繼續成長，而是營收成長與成本成長之間的差距能否持續拉大。

IPO最大的變數，已經被提前到2028年
Anthropic過去三年營收年化速度每年都增加超過10倍，這種成長速度讓投資人願意接受更遠期的估值方式。但同樣的邏輯也放大了IPO定價的風險。
當估值建立在2028年接近2,000億美元的營收，而不是目前約470億美元的營收年化速度，投資人實際支付的價格，很大一部分來自尚未實現的成長。
因此，Anthropic上市後最值得追蹤的指標，可能不只是每季營收有沒有超過預期，而是營收增速、運算支出與營業利益率能否同步朝2028年的假設靠近。
Anthropic若能證明收入持續高速增加，同時GPU、訓練、推論及人事成本占營收比重下降，市場才有理由繼續用遠期營收支撐高估值。反之，一旦營收成長先降速、成本卻沒有同步下降，市場對2028年預測的折價就可能迅速放大。
